clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, The Legend of Stalvan begins with Madame Eva's vision of death for her granddaughter, Alyssa. Her cards and trance leave one name: Stalvan. She sends travelers to the Darkshire Town Hall to search the records.

Madame Eva reads cards and portents for troubled locals in Darkshire. After a terrible disturbance jolts her awake, she draws the Death card for her young granddaughter, Alyssa. Eva enters a deep trance, seeking what the omen means, but finds only one clue: the name Stalvan. Fearing for her family and the town, she asks you to follow that name before tragedy strikes.

Madame Eva sends you across the square to the Darkshire Town Hall to search its records for Stalvan. There you can speak with Clerk Daltry, who keeps the town's ledgers and public archives. He can help determine whether Stalvan once lived in Darkshire, passed through as a traveler, or is a name buried in Duskwood's past.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins. I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger. I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.
After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery. A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.
Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character. I fear for us all.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah so Madame Eva sent you....
